name: agentd-interface
description: The agentd display clients: a shared thin-client core (@agentd/client), the terminal UI (@agentd/tui), and the web UI (@agentd/ui). Separate Node projects — agentd hosts all state; these only render it.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentd/client && npm run build -w @agentd/tui && npm run build -w @agentd/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agentd/client && npm run typecheck -w @agentd/tui && npm run typecheck -w @agentd/ui
